name: Hakabatori to Samurai Musume
source:
This is the story of a slightly indecisive high school girl who is attracted to this, her boyfriend (for the time being), and a slightly mysterious young man (also known as a radio wave natural).

[Edited from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180125184751/https://www.otomedream.com/thread-765219-1-1.html]Otome Dream[/url]]
translation:
这是一个关于有些优柔寡断的高中女生，在（暂且算是）男友与一位略显神秘、又有些电波天然呆的青年之间摇摆的故事。
